default_lifecycle_paragraph: **Default lifecycle (all supported hosts):** `/discussx` → `/planx` → `/implementx` → `/verifyx`. Pre-execution (`discussx`, `planx`) is doc-only; `implementx` runs **all waves in one breath** per `WAVE_STATE.json`; `verifyx` merges verify + ship. Profile `my-light` disables REVIEW_GATE hard block. **legacy-gsd** (`/gsd-*`) is cold-manifest only; tree archived under `skills/_archived/gsd-lifecycle/`.

lifecycle_by_host.cursor: **Default lifecycle: My** (`/implementx` one-breath all waves). Goal/RFV: `framework_goal_drive` / `framework_rfv_loop` stdio + `artifacts/current/<task_id>/` manual boards only (no hook GOAL_CONTINUE/RFV/digest, 2026-05). `my-light` profile: no REVIEW_GATE hard block.
lifecycle_by_host.codex-cli: **Default lifecycle: My** (same chain). Goal/RFV via `framework_goal_drive` / `framework_rfv_loop` stdio + manual boards only; no continuity digest or GOAL_CONTINUE/RFV_LOOP_CONTINUE on hooks.
lifecycle_by_host.codex-app: **Default lifecycle: My** (same chain). Goal/RFV via MCP stdio tools + manual boards; no CLI Stop hook bundle on this transport.
lifecycle_by_host.claude-code: **Default lifecycle: My** (same chain). Goal/RFV via stdio + manual boards; `router-rs claude hook` does not inject GOAL_CONTINUE/RFV/digest (review/closeout advisories only).
lifecycle_by_host.claude-desktop: **Default lifecycle: My** (same chain). Goal drive via MCP stdio; MCP advisory only — no PreToolUse/Stop hard gate.

review_findings_only_paragraph: **Code review default (all hosts): findings-only.** Explicit `$code-review-deep` or review requests still apply; my-light profile does not hard-block Stop on REVIEW_GATE. See `skills/code-review-deep/SKILL.md`.
